details.description: Maturity: 68-72 days, plant vigour: Moderate, Shape: round, colour: bright red, Head diameter: 12-14cm, Head depth: 12-14cm, Average head weight: 1.2-1.4kg, Special attributes: Attractive red colour, firm heads, wide adaptability; recommended for semi tropical climate.

Plant: Large compact, & Erect, Curd: Compact, dome shape, white colour with good leaf coverage, Average curd weight: 1.5 Kg, Duration: Harvest starts in about 70 days from planting, Remarks: Late maturing hybrid.

Arjani F1 eggplant seeds are a high-yielding hybrid variety known for producing uniform, glossy dark purple fruits with a smooth texture, ideal for both local and commercial markets. These plants are vigorous, with an erect habit that keeps fruits off the ground even under heavy loads, and they exhibit intermediate resistance to bacterial wilt. Arjani F1 thrives in well-drained, fertile soils, maturing for harvest in 60-70 days.

Femi F1 is an improved Eggplant hybrid in terms of yield, shelf life and bacterial wilt resistance. The Fruits are very glossy day violet with a smooth skin and excellent firmness. Flesh color is white. It is widely adaptable to a range of growing conditions and ideal for areas where bacterial wilt occurs.

The plants are tall with the production of concentrated fruits which grow upwards. Demon's appeal is fruit quality, bright colour, uniform fruit (8*1cm) and firmness. Maturity: 70-75 days. Color: Red. Length: 7-9 cm. Diameter: 0.9-1.1 cm. Plant vigour: strong

Maradona F1 is a Hybrid with dwarf and strong plants and high setting ability. It bares uniform fruits (1.5-2kg) in shape and size. Fruit flesh is firm, thick and has a very sweet taste (brix: 12-14). It's dwarf growth habit makes it a superior variety since it does not grow very tall making it easy and cost effective to harvest. Intermediate resistant to PRSV and Anthrachnose. Days to maturity: 210-240. Color: Orange. Flowering habit: Dwarf.
details.diseaseResistance: Intermediate resistant to PRSV and Anthrachnose

details.description: Days to maturity after transplant: 70-75 days, Plant vigour: Strong, Fruit length: 8-9cm, Fruit diameter: 8-9cm, Thick fruit walls, Fruit colour: Dark green when immature and bright red when mature, Special attributes: It shows a good combination of vegetative power and earliness; high yielding

Tandi F1 tomato is so outstanding in performance when it comes to earliness, yields, fruit size and quality. It is recommended for Tropical Midland growing condition, dry season. Plant habit is compact and small. Closer planting distance can be considered. Fruit set is easy and concentrated, Fruit shape is elongated blocky and large in size. Fruit firmness and shelf life is rated high. Seed rate: 100 grams per acre, Maturity: 65-75 days after transplanting. Plant Vigour: Medium strong.
Sugar King matures between 71-75 days. It has yellow colour with an average length of 20-21 cm. Its resistant to diseases like corn leaf blight and also is sweet with a good shelf life

This is a very Early maturing, Drought resilient variety with wide adaptability scope. Duma is the Swahili name for cheetah and just like the cheetah, Duma 43 is known for its speed. It is a very early maturing maize hybrid. SC Duma 43 is in the 400 series and is a heat and drought tolerant hybrid. It has high shelling percentage with hard dent grain texture and a good disease tolerant package. It has very white grain colour with excellent cob rot tolerance. This variety is good for inter-cropping regimes. It matures between 85-90 days. Expected yield per acre is 30-32 bags (90kg) per acre with good agronomy practices. Seed rate: 10kgs/Acre.
